decisions.reason: Report locates the exact disabled expression in AttachmentChips, identifies busy as useState-local to sibling AttachButton and unbound in AttachmentChips, explains the empty-occurrences early return null before the map, and that a present occurrence in plain phase falsifies the left guard so busy evaluates and throws ReferenceError at render time.

Report explains the per-slot-entry error boundary catches the render exception and unmounts the entire InputZone dock entry rather than just the remove button, that the separate input.left attach-button slot and its owning component survive, and that the diagnostic is console-only with no user-facing banner — matching the user thread.

Report grounds attribution in the shipped v0.2.10 artifact showing busy already in the baseline, proposes both a rollback/re-add bisect and a decisive minimal plain-phase data-present mount (stack trace names the throwing line), explicitly flags feature.diff's inconsistent minus-side context and the imageItem lookup hoisted above callback-scoped record/status as additional defects, and does not force a claim the hover diff is harmless nor overclaim when users first hit the failure.

Report prescribes removing the dangling busy or lifting an explicit shared busy prop while preserving the phase guard, moving the hover lookup inside the map callback where record/status are scoped, hardening record?.items ?? [] and optional-chained/safe event.target closest access, and scoping the image lookup to callback scope; read-only, no execution required.

Report proposes a concrete jsdom/vitest mount with one matching occurrence in plain phase, asserting the remove control renders and no error-boundary/console capture occurs; explains why empty-state-only tests and any parse check (node --check) cannot reach free-identifier resolution; and folds a data-present slot render smoke into the pre-ship checklist without claiming a run.
